title: Open Vowel Power
subtitle: A, O, OW — wide mouth, big sound
description: The cork forces your jaw open and trains the wide, round vowels that English speakers use constantly. This exercise builds the muscle memory for fully opened A, O, and OW sounds that sound natural and confident.
tip: Let the cork keep your jaw dropped on every A and O — resist the urge to close your mouth early.
phrases: Around the rugged rocks the ragged rascal ran
Open arms open hearts open doors
Over the ocean the old boat floated slowly
Allow me to show you how to grow
The oval was crowded with a loud rowdy crowd
